title: The Ultimate Local Marketing Guide for Your Small Business

facts.fact: Kissmetrics, a marketing analytics firm, found a clear connection between page load time and visitors abandoning the site.
facts.quote: Marketing analytics firm, Kissmetrics found a clear connection between load time and people abandoning the site.

facts.fact: According to HubSpot, 50% of people who visit a local business on mobile will visit the physical location within 24 hours.
facts.quote: 50% of people who visit a local business on mobile, will visit the physical location within 24 hours, according to Hubspot

facts.fact: 88% of customers now check at least one review before deciding to do business with a company.
facts.quote: 88% of customers now check at least one review before deciding to do business with you.

facts.quote: It doesn’t matter that 78% of the world’s population is on at least one social media site if you’re not attracting people who can become customers.

facts.quote: Try these 13 tips for building a local following:

facts.fact: The article defines citations for local SEO as any reference to a business's location, whether or not it is linked.
facts.quote: Citations include any reference to the location of your business whether they are linked or not.

facts.fact: The page says Google Ads radius targeting lets an ad reach anyone within a set distance of a location, without being limited by arbitrary city limits.
facts.quote: One of the reasons that radius is an effective location option is because it doesn’t limit your ad based upon arbitrary city limits.

facts.fact: The page says Google Ads location targeting is set under Settings > select campaigns to edit > change location > enter locations.
facts.quote: Just go under settings > select campaigns to edit > select change location > enter locations.

facts.fact: The page gives the Google Ads radius targeting path as Campaign > choose a campaign to edit > Locations > choose your location and radius.
facts.quote: From the Ads side menu click campaign > choose a campaign to edit > select locations > choose your location and radius.

facts.fact: The page advises that paying an influencer thousands of dollars for a small action is rarely worth it; it gives no specific dollar figure.
facts.quote: But it’s rarely worth it to pay thousands for a small action on their part.

facts.fact: The page recommends that a landing page for a local business include a phone number that is clickable on the mobile version.
facts.quote: If you have a phone number, include it and make it clickable on the mobile version.

facts.fact: The page advises that forms on a local business landing page should sit above the fold.
facts.quote: Forms should be above the fold
